name: Halftime 140 stomp
desc: Dubstep halftime foundation at 140: shaped 909 kick on the one, fat 808 snare+clap on beat 3, ticking 808 hats that saw-pump and open up. Ghost-kick pickups appear in the full pattern, roll fills every 8 bars, crash marks every 4th bar at peak.

code.full: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ [~ bd] ~]>").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.5).gain(${gain}), s("~ ~ [sd,cp] ~").bank("RolandTR808").shape(.35).room(.35).gain(${gain}*.85), s("[hh hh hh hh] [hh hh oh hh]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(saw.range(${hats}*.5, ${hats}).fast(2)).lpf(sine.range(3500,8000).slow(32)), s("~ rim ~ [~ rim]").gain(.3)).every(${fill}, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ [~ bd] ~] [bd ~ ~ [bd bd]]>").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.55).gain(${gain}), s("~ ~ [sd,cp] ~").bank("RolandTR808").shape(.4).room(.4).gain(${gain}*.9), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR808").ply("<1 1 2 1>").gain(saw.range(${hats}*.55, ${hats}).fast(4)).lpf(sine.range(4500,9500).slow(16)), s("rim(5,16,<0 2 4 6>)").gain(.32), s("~ ~ ~ [~ cr]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.25).mask("<0 0 0 1>")).lastOf(${fill}, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
